tags.name: Tragedy
tags.description: Centers around tragic events and unhappy endings.

tags.name: Male Protagonist
tags.description: Main character is male.

tags.name: Reincarnation
tags.description: Features a character being born again after death, typically as another person or in another world.

tags.name: Isekai
tags.description: Features a character from a modern-day setting being transported into an alternate world and has to adapt to their new surroundings.

tags.name: Polyamorous
tags.description: Features a character who is in a consenting relationship with multiple people at one time.

tags.name: Heterosexual
tags.description: Prominently features a romance between a man and a woman, not inherently sexual.

tags.name: Coming of Age
tags.description: Centers around a character's transition from childhood to adulthood.

tags.name: Family Life
tags.description: Centers around the activities of a family unit.

tags.name: Swordplay
tags.description: Prominently features the use of swords in combat.

tags.name: Medieval
tags.description: Partially or completely set in the Middle Ages or a Middle Ages-inspired setting. Commonly features elements such as European castles and knights.

tags.name: Female Harem
tags.description: Main cast features the protagonist plus several female characters who are romantically interested in them.

tags.name: Magic
tags.description: Prominently features magical elements or the use of magic.

tags.name: Time Loop
tags.description: A character is stuck in a repetitive cycle that they are attempting to break out of. This is distinct from a manipulating time of their own choice.

tags.name: Snowscape
tags.description: Prominently or partially set in a snowy environment.

tags.name: Marriage
tags.description: Centers around marriage between two or more characters.

tags.name: Time Manipulation
tags.description: Prominently features time-traveling or other time-warping phenomena.

tags.name: Alternate Universe
tags.description: Features multiple alternate universes in the same series.

tags.name: Revenge
tags.description: Prominently features a character who aims to exact punishment in a resentful or vindictive manner.

tags.name: Politics
tags.description: Centers around politics, politicians, or government activities.

tags.name: Gods
tags.description: Prominently features a character of divine or religious nature.

tags.name: Demons
tags.description: Prominently features malevolent otherworldly creatures.

tags.name: Elf
tags.description: Prominently features a character who is an elf.

tags.name: Kemonomimi
tags.description: Prominently features humanoid characters with animal ears.

tags.name: Age Gap
tags.description: Prominently features romantic relations between people with a significant age difference.

tags.name: Maids
tags.description: Prominently features a character who is a maid.

tags.name: Disability
tags.description: A work that features one or more characters with a physical, mental, cognitive, or developmental condition that impairs, interferes with, or limits the person's ability to engage in certain tasks or actions.

tags.name: Primarily Adult Cast
tags.description: Main cast is mostly composed of characters above a high school age.

tags.name: Delinquents
tags.description: Features characters with a notorious image and attitude, sometimes referred to as "yankees".

tags.name: College
tags.description: Partly or completely set in a college or university.

tags.name: Love Triangle
tags.description: Centered around romantic feelings between more than two people. Includes all love polygons.

tags.name: Amnesia
tags.description: Prominently features a character(s) with memory loss.

tags.name: Desert
tags.description: Prominently features a desert environment.
